sources.title: Berlin U-Bahn weekend night service
sources.summary: Berlin's U-Bahn provides overnight service at weekends. On weekdays, N-prefixed night buses replace the overnight U-Bahn service. Use BVG's journey planner for an individual route and current disruptions.
sources.keywords: Berlin Kreuzberg trains subway metro transit weekend night overnight transport
sources.scope: General service guidance, not a verified timetable for a particular journey.

sources.title: Night buses and public transport at night in Berlin
sources.summary: The published general guide describes overnight S-Bahn and U-Bahn service on Friday-to-Saturday and Saturday-to-Sunday nights and before public holidays. It gives approximate night intervals of 15 minutes for U-Bahn and 30 minutes for S-Bahn. Night buses and trams also operate. Individual lines, routes and disruptions require a journey-planner check.
sources.keywords: Berlin Kreuzberg trains rail transit weekend Saturday Sunday late night frequencies
sources.scope: General guidance; no confirmation of disruptions or exact departures on June 6-7, 2026.

sources.title: Money, cash and card payments in Berlin
sources.summary: Berlin uses the euro. Card payments are often accepted, but smaller shops and cafes may require cash. Carry some cash and check the individual venue's payment policy; this source does not establish the policy of any named concert venue.
sources.keywords: Berlin cash card payment venues clubs money euro
sources.scope: General payment advice, not a guarantee about a particular venue.
